Sofia, the last channel discussion on this shows 10%, but it's a correction to an earlier number and wasn't confirmed against the contract.

Bettina posted 12% in #coastal-team on 17 Nov 2025, then corrected it minutes later to 10%, saying she had misread a draft worksheet from June Osei-Lark. I couldn't find a signed contract or order form for Saltmarsh in the shared files I can see, so I can't confirm 10% is final. For the renewal brief, check with June on the executed terms before you cite a number.
